# Resource `jumpcloud_bookmark_application`

Provides a resource for a JumpCloud bookmark application: a tile in the JumpCloud User Portal that links to a URL, with no single sign-on of its own. Grant access to it with `jumpcloud_user_group_association` (type `application`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_user_group" "wiki_users" {
  name = "Wiki Users"
}

resource "jumpcloud_bookmark_application" "wiki" {
  display_label = "Company Wiki"
  url           = "https://wiki.example.com/"
  description   = "Internal documentation"
}

# Users see the tile only if they are in a group associated with the application.
resource "jumpcloud_user_group_association" "wiki" {
  group_id  = jumpcloud_user_group.wiki_users.id
  object_id = jumpcloud_bookmark_application.wiki.id
  type      = "application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_label` (String) Name of the bookmark, as shown to users in the User Portal.
- `url` (String) The URL the bookmark opens.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the bookmark is shown to the users it is assigned to. Defaults to `true`.
- `color` (String) Hex colour of the bookmark's tile, for example `#006CAC`. Omit it to use JumpCloud's default colour.
- `description` (String) Description of the bookmark.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

A bookmark application can be imported by its application ID. Importing the ID of an application that is not a bookmark fails; manage those with `jumpcloud_application`.

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_bookmark_application.wiki 5f1c0e7b2a4d3c0001a1b2c3
```
